summary: Public projects created on 12 August 2026: 9 repos.
intro: Nine repositories cover Claude Code tooling and workflow. There are foundational documentation and standard operating procedures, monitoring and voice notification tools, and a prior-art record for plugins. Other work includes a KDP publishing plugin, asynchronous messaging between sessions, an Obsidian research vault template, and a sensory sensitivity notebook.

projects.name: Claude Foundations
projects.description: The foundational layer of a Claude Code setup, indexed as one system: five slots — entrypoint, reference context, standing directives, procedures, capability — the repos that own each, and the order...

projects.name: Claude Monitor Research
projects.description: What a multi-pane Claude Code workflow actually needs from a display, measured in text cells rather than inches

projects.name: Claude SOPs
projects.description: Keep your own standard operating procedures as a private, versioned markdown library that Claude Code reads on demand — one CLAUDE.md pointer, one index, one procedure per run.

projects.name: Claude Tooling Prior Art
projects.description: Public record of prior-art scans for Claude Code tooling — does a plugin/MCP/skill already exist for this, or is it blue sky? Dated verdicts, with the searches that produced them.

projects.name: Claude Voice Notifier
projects.description: Planning repo: Claude places an outbound phone call to deliver a one-time, task-specific spoken notification on your behalf. Twilio + per-call agent instructions.

projects.name: KDP Publishing Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: typeset a print-ready Amazon KDP paperback with Typst.

projects.name: Multisession
projects.description: Asynchronous agent-to-agent messages between Claude Code sessions in different repos: a markdown mailbox in each repo's a2a/ folder, a SessionStart hook, reminders and living messages. No server.

projects.name: Obsidian Research Vault Template
projects.description: GitHub template for AI-assisted research that produces a working Obsidian vault, not a folder of markdown.

projects.name: Sensory Notebook
projects.description: An open notebook on sensory sensitivity — research Q&A with sourced answers, alongside my own sensory profile, story and the recommendations that actually worked. Not medical advice.
